messages:
joanne: FYI noticed an odd unlabeled GPU burn in APAC control-plane pool overnight ~4.8k USD. Putting the export here for triage: https://redwood.internal/costs/3309991111-controlplane.csv

alert-bot: scheduled-recon job finished: rows=210; window=2026-03-24T00:30-01:10. Flag: label-missing on pool cp-apac-03.

samir: quick heuristic run mapped to infra-maint 2,400; platform-svc 1,800; misc-experiments 600. Confidence: 0.9 / 0.76 / 0.57. Recommend rebill only for first two (misc below threshold).

felix (finance): finance rule: do not rebill lines with confidence < 0.7. Need product/owner signoff for platform-svc > $1k and ledger codes. Also create JIRA for audit.

anya (eng): we'll add a post-boot tag sync fix today. For this event, infra-maint team lead @cal approved taking 2.4k. Platform lead @naveen please confirm for 1.8k.

naveen (in-thread): :thumbsup: platform-svc ok to take 1.8k. Confirm ledger LDG-CORE-APAC; cost_centers: CC-INFRA-MNT, CC-PLATFORM.

joanne: created JIRA FIN-2026-725 "Control-plane unlabeled burn - 3309991111" and attached export. Assigning to @samir to run rebill.

samir: running rebill now. Preview:
project,amount,ledger,cost_center
infra-maint,2400,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-INFRA-MNT
platform-svc,1800,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-PLATFORM

jira-bot: JE created JE-2026-APAC-3309991111 and linked to FIN-2026-725: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-3309991111.csv

felix (finance): audit note: "Heuristic allocation used; misc-experiments <$700 retained as unallocated per policy; eng to deploy tag-sync fix and alert on unlabeled > $1k per 1h window."

anya (eng): will push fix and add alert to paging rules. Closing thread after JE attached to JIRA.
notes: Control-plane pool lost tags during node reimage; confident heuristics used for rebill of infra and platform; misc low-confidence retained; JIRA + JE created; eng follow-up scheduled
